# betteredge_ted (Resource)

A Trusted Execution Domain (TED) on the BetterEdge platform. The platform API has no update endpoint, so every attribute forces replacement on change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "ted_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "betteredge_ted" "example" {
  project_id  = betteredge_project.example.id
  os_name     = "Ubuntu-26"
  vcpu        = 2
  memory_gb   = 2
  storage_gb  = 50
  description = "Created by Terraform"
  password    = var.ted_password
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Free-text description for the created TED.
- `memory_gb` (Number) Memory size in GB. Must be one of the values returned by the platform's config endpoint.
- `os_name` (String) Operating system image to use. Must be one of the values returned by the platform's config endpoint.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the default user. Required by the platform API regardless of include_ssh_keys.
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project the TED will be created in.
- `storage_gb` (Number) Storage size in GB. Must be one of the values returned by the platform's config endpoint.
- `vcpu` (Number) Number of vCPUs. Must be one of the values returned by the platform's config endpoint.

### Optional

- `include_ssh_keys` (Boolean) Whether to also grant SSH access via public_ssh_keys, in addition to the password.
- `module_id` (String) UUID of the module to place the TED on. If omitted, the platform chooses placement automatically.
- `public_ssh_keys` (List of String) List of SSH public keys to authorize. Required when include_ssh_keys is true.
- `server_id` (String) UUID of the server to place the TED on. If omitted, the platform chooses placement automatically.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the TED.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import betteredge_ted.example 9bf980e3-f691-4edf-b43a-eefc25f8c9f5
```
